name: Tyrone Marhguy
tagline: Computers from first principles — and the software that brings them to life.
bio: Computer Engineering Junior at Penn specializing in physical hardware implementation and verification — RTL through Sky130 ASIC flow, open-source EDA contributions (Verilator, LibreLane, OpenROAD, OpenFPGA), and builds from a 32-bit CPU and hybrid transistor ALU to a 22nm SRAM macro.
hardwareTrack: RTL, FPGA, and ASIC implementation — from discrete logic to chip design.
softwareTrack: Production backends, embedded firmware, and tooling.
